sasha: FYI Nimbus.ai flagged invoice INV-2026-0159 — looks like they were billed twice for the same background job run. Can ops/finance confirm?
omar: I pulled the metering. There's a duplicate payload re-ingest on 2026-02-15 (usage_id U-77 repeated) so tokens counted twice. 
ashwin: ouch. How much is the duplicate line?
omar: Duplicate tokens ~2,500,000 at $0.0005 = $1,250. Customer also had a $100 onboarding promo that applied originally. Net customer-facing refund requested = $1,150.
ashwin: That exceeds Elaine's $1k auto-approve, tagging @elaine and @maria for sign-off.
elaine: Can you attach the meter log snippet and confirm it's not a customer retry?
omar: Snippet: ```
usage_id,U-77,timestamp,2026-02-15T03:12:07Z,tokens,2500000,source,background_worker
usage_id,U-77,timestamp,2026-02-15T03:12:07Z,tokens,2500000,source,background_worker
```
We confirmed customer system didn't resubmit; looks like internal reprocess.
elaine: Thanks. I'm comfortable approving up to $1k; but because this is $1,150 need finance lead approval.
maria: I can approve the extra $150 as goodwill for platform error. Approved. Please mark as "goodwill: metering_dup" and flag engineering.
omar: Creating manual credit now:
```
# manual credit for duplicate metering
billingctl credit --customer NIMBUS-17 --invoice INV-2026-0159 --amount 1150.00 --currency USD --reason "goodwill: metering_dup"
```
billing-bot: Credit created: cr_1Kf8YbZ3, amount $1,150.00, status: pending.
omar: Ledger entry REF-2026-112 posted, invoice marked adjusted. Please include in Feb adjustments file.
ashwin: I'll send the customer email: apology, refundable amount, and revised invoice. Will cc support and account team.
maria: Also opened ENG ticket (ENG-3842) to update metering job to dedupe ingestion. Assigning to infra team.
elaine: Noted. Added to Q1 manual adjustments sheet. Thanks everyone for quick action. :thumbsup:
sasha: Customer acknowledged and said they appreciate the fast fix. Closing thread.
